# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: DDR 1970 scripted effects — scripted effects.
## COLDWAR | Cold War mod (MD Imperia) - German Democratic Republic 1970
## Generated by the COLDWAR GDR generator (Claude outputs/COLDWAR_DDR_generator) from the approved design v3 (layout 19.10.2026)

## Search for 'COLDWAR' to find every Cold War addition.

# called from the 1970 history of the GDR (history/countries/DDR - East Germany.txt)
COLDWAR_DDR_initialize_1970 = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_initialized } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_initialized
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb
		# laws, internal factions and the seven starting spirits
		add_ideas = {
			bureau_04
			defence_05
			police_05
			edu_04
			health_04
			social_04
			draft_army
			officer_military_academy
			md_closed_economy
			comprehensive_regulations
			fully_nationalized_healthcare
			censored_nation_05
			communist_cadres
			intelligence_community
			the_military
			industrial_conglomerates
			labour_unions
			farmers
			the_clergy
			small_medium_business_owners
			COLDWAR_DDR_antifascist_protection_rampart
			COLDWAR_DDR_overtaking_without_catching_up
			COLDWAR_DDR_the_soviet_garrison
			COLDWAR_DDR_diplomatic_quarantine
			COLDWAR_DDR_the_labour_shortage
			COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite
			COLDWAR_DDR_the_window_to_the_west
		}
		set_variable = { communist_cadres_opinion = 75 }
		set_variable = { intelligence_community_opinion = 70 }
		set_variable = { the_military_opinion = 65 }
		set_variable = { industrial_conglomerates_opinion = 55 }
		set_variable = { labour_unions_opinion = 55 }
		set_variable = { farmers_opinion = 50 }
		set_variable = { the_clergy_opinion = 30 }
		set_variable = { small_medium_business_owners_opinion = 35 }
		initialize_internal_faction_dynamic_modifiers = yes
		# Moscow's Trust (0-100) and the Inner-German course (shadow of the balance of power, -1 Demarcation .. +1 Rapprochement)
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust = 48 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_course = -0.25 }
		set_power_balance = { id = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop left_side = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop_left_side right_side = COLDWAR_DDR_german_course_bop_right_side set_value = -0.25 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_mfs_intel_network_gain_factor = 0.1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_mfs_police_cost_multiplier_modifier = 0.05 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_socialist_camp_opinion_gain_monthly_same_ideology_factor = 0.1 }
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_socialist_camp_mdcw_cw_support_effectiveness = 0.05 }
		# the five country modifiers (MD: base modifiers at the start; the foci of each area strengthen them)
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_party_state_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_planned_economy_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_nva_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_mfs_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_socialist_camp_modifier }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_brothers_in_arms }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_garrison_relief }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_reliable_ally }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_displeasure }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_brezhnev_doctrine }
		# the parties of the republic (design start popularities)
		set_popularities = { democratic = 12 communism = 72 neutrality = 11 nationalist = 5 fascism = 0 }
		set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
		IMP_1970_clear_politics = yes
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^0 = 0.01 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^1 = 0.05 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^2 = 0.04 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^3 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^4 = 0.64 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^5 = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^6 = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^7 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^13 = 0.02 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^14 = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^15 = 0.01 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^16 = 0.01 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^17 = 0.005 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^18 = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^19 = 0.005 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^20 = 0.03 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^22 = 0.015 }
		set_variable = { party_pop_array^23 = 0.005 }
		set_variable = { ruling_party = 4 }
		startup_politics = yes
	}
}

# THIS pays a share of its GDP to the country in temp COLDWAR_DDR_transfer_target (temp COLDWAR_DDR_gdp_share, positive)
COLDWAR_DDR_transfer_gdp_share = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_amount = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_amount = COLDWAR_DDR_gdp_share }
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_DDR_amount }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	var:COLDWAR_DDR_transfer_target = {
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_DDR_amount }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
	}
}

# ---- outlook popularity: the ruling party if it belongs to the outlook, otherwise the outlook's main GDR party
COLDWAR_DDR_change_outlook_popularity = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_outlook_id = 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > -1 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 4 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_outlook_id = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 3 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 10 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 4 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_outlook_id = 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 11 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 20 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 18 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_outlook_id = 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ruling_party > 19 } check_variable = { ruling_party < 24 } }
			set_temp_variable = { party_index = ruling_party }
		}
		else = { set_temp_variable = { party_index = 20 } }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { party_popularity_increase = COLDWAR_DDR_outlook_amount }
	set_temp_variable = { temp_outlook_increase = COLDWAR_DDR_outlook_amount }
	change_relative_party_popularity = yes
}

# ---- Moscow's Trust (0-100; temp COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta). The tooltip is shown by the caller. ----------
COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = {
	add_to_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust = COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta }
	clamp_variable = { var = COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust min = 0 max = 100 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

# monthly (on_monthly_DDR): -1 at Rapprochement 0.4 or more, -1 while a non-Emerging government rules,
# +1 at Demarcation -0.4 or less while the SED governs (only up to 70); the Ambassador calls below 25
COLDWAR_DDR_monthly = {
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_pending NOT = { country_exists = SOV } } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_pending }
	# Moscow's Trust only matters while the republic is in the Soviet orbit (a subject of Moscow or in the Warsaw Pact)
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_DDR_in_soviet_orbit = yes }
		COLDWAR_DDR_monthly_trust = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_monthly_trust = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = 0 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_course > 0.39 } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = -1 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_government = communism } } add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = -1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_course < -0.39 } emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust < 70 } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = 0 } } } COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust < 25 }
			country_exists = SOV
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_ambassador_cooldown }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_ambassador_cooldown days = 365 }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.31 days = 1 }
	}
	# a computer-led Soviet Union courts a rival when trust is low (a human one decides itself, with a decision)
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust < 31 }
			emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes
			country_exists = SOV
			SOV = { is_ai = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_soviet_endorses_change }
		}
		COLDWAR_DDR_soviet_endorses_change = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_soviet_endorses_change = {
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.52 days = 1 }
}

# ---- the Kremlin's say: a human Soviet Union hears of key steps and may endorse (+5) or object (-5)
COLDWAR_DDR_notify_kremlin_first_sec = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = no NOT = { tag = ROOT } } has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_initialized } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.48 days = 1 } } }
}
COLDWAR_DDR_notify_kremlin_western_credit = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = no NOT = { tag = ROOT } } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.49 days = 1 } } }
}
COLDWAR_DDR_notify_kremlin_basic_treaty = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { is_ai = no NOT = { tag = ROOT } } } SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.50 days = 1 } } }
}
COLDWAR_DDR_kremlin_endorses = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = 5 }
	COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.51 days = 1 }
}
COLDWAR_DDR_kremlin_objects = {
	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_trust_delta = -5 }
	COLDWAR_DDR_change_trust = yes
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.53 days = 1 }
}

# ---- Fraternal Assistance: the Soviet Union may decide to intervene (its decision, Moscow category of the Soviet side)
COLDWAR_DDR_open_fraternal_assistance = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_fraternal_open_tt
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_fraternal_assistance_open days = 365 }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_bow_to_moscow = {
	add_stability = -0.10
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_bow_to_moscow_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust < 50 } } set_variable = { COLDWAR_DDR_moscow_trust = 50 } force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_fraternal_assistance_open
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes } } COLDWAR_DDR_restore_party_rule = yes }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_resist_fraternal_assistance = {
	add_war_support = 0.10
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_resist_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { is_subject_of = SOV } SOV = { end_puppet = PREV } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_leave_warsaw_pact = yes
		if = { limit = { country_exists = SOV NOT = { has_war_with = SOV } } SOV = { declare_war_on = { target = PREV type = topple_government } } }
	}
}

# ---- the Warsaw Pact, the garrison, accession ----------------------------------------------------
COLDWAR_DDR_leave_warsaw_pact = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_leave_wp_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		# MD's own exit (array, idea, tech sharing, faction, news); called from our own events, so ROOT is the republic
		if = { limit = { has_idea = Warsaw_Pact_member } Warsaw_Pact_leave = yes }
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	}
}

# THIS = the republic (called in Bonn's answer). While it is Moscow's subject, the Soviet Union decides first (Two Plus Four).
COLDWAR_DDR_start_accession = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_subject_of = SOV }
		custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_accession_moscow_tt
		hidden_effect = { SOV = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.64 days = 1 } } }
	}
	else = { COLDWAR_DDR_begin_transition = yes }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_begin_transition = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_accession_tt
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_DDR_accession_transition days = 365 }
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_accession_pending
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.60 days = 365 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_complete_accession = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_accession_pending
	COLDWAR_DDR_leave_warsaw_pact = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_social_charter }
		GER = { add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_DDR_eastern_social_charter days = 1825 } }
	}
	GER = { annex_country = { target = PREV transfer_troops = yes } }
}

# ---- elections ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
COLDWAR_DDR_allow_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_allow_elections_tt
	set_variable = { disable_elections = 0 }
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = yes } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = yes } }
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_suspend_elections = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_suspend_elections_tt
	set_variable = { disable_elections = 1 }
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_government = democratic } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = communism } set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = fascism } set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = neutrality } set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } }
		if = { limit = { has_government = nationalist } set_politics = { ruling_party = nationalist elections_allowed = no } }
	}
}

# ==== ladders: one active form at a time (steps get lighter with 'down'; 'clear' ends every form) =====
COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_border_clear = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_antifascist_protection_rampart } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_antifascist_protection_rampart }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_border_the_perfected_border } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_border_the_perfected_border }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_border_the_iron_border } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_border_the_iron_border }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_border_the_border_with_gates } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_border_the_border_with_gates }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_labour_clear = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_the_labour_shortage } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_the_labour_shortage }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_3 }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_labour_down = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_the_labour_shortage }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_the_labour_shortage
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_2 }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_2
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_3 }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_labour_shortage_3
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_lignite_clear = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_energy_coal_instead_of_oil } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_energy_coal_instead_of_oil }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_2 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_3 } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_3 }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_lignite_down = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_energy_coal_instead_of_oil }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_energy_coal_instead_of_oil
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_2
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_2 }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_2
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_3
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_3 }
		remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_king_lignite_3
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_overtaking_clear = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_overtaking_without_catching_up } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_overtaking_without_catching_up }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_koko_doc_hard_currency } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_koko_doc_hard_currency }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_koko_doc_firm } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_koko_doc_firm }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_cdu_doc_social_economy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_cdu_doc_social_economy }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_cdu_doc_social_market } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_cdu_doc_social_market }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_ldpd_doc_social_market } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_ldpd_doc_social_market }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_ldpd_doc_convertible_mark } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_ldpd_doc_convertible_mark }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_spd_doc_social_state } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_spd_doc_social_state }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_spd_doc_codetermination } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_spd_doc_codetermination }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_ndpd_doc_national_economy } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_ndpd_doc_national_economy }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_ndpd_doc_quality_work } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_ndpd_doc_quality_work }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_nrf_doc_autarky } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_nrf_doc_autarky }

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_recognition_clear = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_diplomatic_quarantine } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_diplomatic_quarantine }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_partial_recognition } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_partial_recognition }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_recognised_state } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_recognised_state }
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_recognition_down = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_diplomatic_quarantine }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_diplomatic_quarantine
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_partial_recognition
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_partial_recognition }
		swap_ideas = {
			remove_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_partial_recognition
			add_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_rec_recognised_state
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_ladder_window_clear = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_the_window_to_the_west } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_the_window_to_the_west }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_we_the_open_window } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_we_the_open_window }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_soc_the_antenna_raids } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_soc_the_antenna_raids }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_soc_the_tolerated_window } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_soc_the_tolerated_window }
}

# ==== First Secretaries of the SED ===============================================================
COLDWAR_DDR_clear_first_sec = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_sto
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_mit
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hag
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hof
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_lam
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kro
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kre
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_mod
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_kessler_leads
}

COLDWAR_DDR_clear_heirs = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_ulb
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hon
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_sto
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_mit
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hag
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hof
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_lam
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_kro
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_kre
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_mod
}

COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_ulb = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_install_ulb_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		COLDWAR_DDR_clear_first_sec = yes
		COLDWAR_DDR_clear_heirs = yes
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_retiring
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_pending
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb
		if = {
			limit = { emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_walter_ulbricht" picture = "gfx/Leaders/DDR/DDR_Coldwar_WalterUlbricht.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_the_architect_of_the_republic } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_founder_of_the_republic }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.45 hours = 6 }
		}
		COLDWAR_DDR_notify_kremlin_first_sec = yes
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_set_heir_ulb = {
	COLDWAR_DDR_clear_heirs = yes
	set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_ulb
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_ulb_tt
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_retiring has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb } hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.44 days = 7 } } }
}

		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kre
		if = {
			limit = { emerging_communist_state_are_in_power = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_egon_krenz" picture = "gfx/leaders/DDR/DDR_Egon_Krenz.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_kre_a_younger_face } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_kre_the_fdj_generation }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.45 hours = 6 }
		}
		COLDWAR_DDR_notify_kremlin_first_sec = yes
		force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	}
}

# the designated heir is elected; otherwise the Central Committee chooses among the living (event)
COLDWAR_DDR_succession = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_ulb COLDWAR_DDR_alive_ulb = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_ulb = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hon COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hon = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_hon = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_sto COLDWAR_DDR_alive_sto = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_sto } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_sto = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_mit COLDWAR_DDR_alive_mit = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_mit } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_mit = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hag COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hag = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hag } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_hag = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hof COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hof = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hof } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_hof = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_lam COLDWAR_DDR_alive_lam = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_lam } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_lam = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_kro COLDWAR_DDR_alive_kro = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kro } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_kro = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_kre COLDWAR_DDR_alive_kre = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kre } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_kre = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_mod COLDWAR_DDR_alive_mod = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_mod } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_mod = yes
	}
	else = {
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.43 days = 1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_leader_dies_hof = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_dies_hof_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_dead_hof
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hof }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_hof_kessler_junta_option NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_kessler_refused } }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.7 days = 1 }
			}
			else = { COLDWAR_DDR_succession = yes }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hof } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_hof }
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_leader_dies_lam = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_dies_lam_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_dead_lam
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_lam } COLDWAR_DDR_succession = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_lam } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_lam }
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_leader_dies_ulb = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_DDR_dies_ulb_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_dead_ulb
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb } COLDWAR_DDR_succession = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_ulb } clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_heir_ulb }
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_restore_party_rule = {
	set_temp_variable = { rul_party_temp = 4 }
	change_ruling_party_effect = yes
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_kessler_leads }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_heinz_kessler" picture = "gfx/leaders/DDR/DDR_Heinz_Kessler.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_hof_army_general
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb COLDWAR_DDR_alive_ulb = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_walter_ulbricht" picture = "gfx/Leaders/DDR/DDR_Coldwar_WalterUlbricht.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_the_architect_of_the_republic } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_ulb_founder_of_the_republic }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hon = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_erich_honecker" picture = "gfx/leaders/DDR/honecker.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_hon_the_roofer_from_the_saar } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_hon_man_of_the_apparatus }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_sto COLDWAR_DDR_alive_sto = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_willi_stoph" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_sto_the_man_from_erfurt } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_sto_the_administrator }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_mit COLDWAR_DDR_alive_mit = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_guenter_mittag" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_mit_the_master_of_the_balance_sheet } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_mit_economic_czar }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hag COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hag = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_kurt_hager" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_hag_the_chief_ideologist } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_hag_keeper_of_the_doctrine }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hof COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hof = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_heinz_hoffmann" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_hof_comrade_army_general } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_hof_army_general }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_hof_marshal_of_the_gdr } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_hof_marshal_of_the_gdr }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_lam COLDWAR_DDR_alive_lam = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_werner_lamberz" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_lam_the_gdrs_kennedy } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_lam_the_gdrs_kennedy }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kro COLDWAR_DDR_alive_kro = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_werner_krolikowski" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_kro_loyalty_without_reservation } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_kro_moscows_man }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_kre COLDWAR_DDR_alive_kre = yes }
			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_egon_krenz" picture = "gfx/leaders/DDR/DDR_Egon_Krenz.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_kre_a_younger_face } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_kre_the_fdj_generation }

			retire_country_leader = yes
			create_country_leader = { name = "COLDWAR_DDR_leader_hans_modrow" picture = "gfx/leaders/DDR/DDR_Hans_Modrow.dds" ideology = communist_state traits = { emerging_communist_state } }
			if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_DDR_mod_the_man_from_dresden } add_country_leader_trait = COLDWAR_DDR_mod_the_dresden_reformer }
		}
		else = {
			COLDWAR_DDR_succession = yes
		}
	}
}

# THIS = GDR; the Kremlin (human Soviet Union) has answered
COLDWAR_DDR_cc_approved = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_pending
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 1 } COLDWAR_DDR_alive_ulb = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_ulb } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_ulb = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 2 } COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hon = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hon } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_hon = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 3 } COLDWAR_DDR_alive_sto = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_sto } }

	else_if = {

		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_mit = yes

	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 5 } COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hag = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hag } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 6 } COLDWAR_DDR_alive_hof = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_first_sec_hof } }
		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_hof = yes

	else_if = {

		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_kre = yes
	}
	else_if = {

		COLDWAR_DDR_install_first_sec_mod = yes
	}
}

COLDWAR_DDR_cc_vetoed = {
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_pending
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_ulb days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 2 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_hon days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 3 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_sto days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 4 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_mit days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 5 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_hag days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 6 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_hof days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 7 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_lam days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 8 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_kro days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 9 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_kre days = 180 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_DDR_cc_candidate = 10 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_DDR_cc_failed_mod days = 180 }
	}
	country_event = { id = COLDWAR_DDR.47 days = 1 }
}


COLDWAR_DDR_clear_plan_priority = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_housing } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_housing }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_key_industries } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_key_industries }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_exports } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_exports }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_defence } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_defence }
}

# monthly: a priority ends with its plan
COLDWAR_DDR_monthly_plan = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1971_chosen date > 1975.12.31 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1971_ended } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1971_ended
		COLDWAR_DDR_clear_plan_priority = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1976_chosen date > 1980.12.31 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1976_ended } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1976_ended
		COLDWAR_DDR_clear_plan_priority = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1981_chosen date > 1985.12.31 NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1981_ended } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_DDR_plan_1981_ended
		COLDWAR_DDR_clear_plan_priority = yes
	}
}
